policy: All entries are candidates unless explicitly marked otherwise. Verify official documentation, pricing, data processing, country access, account eligibility and integration scopes before adoption.

tools.name: n8n
tools.purpose: Connect approved services and automate repeatable workflows
watchouts: credentials must be stored securely
self-hosting requires patching, backups and monitoring
review licence for intended use

tools.name: Zapier
watchouts: task limits and paid tiers
data passes through third-party services
verify each connector action

tools.name: Tally
tools.purpose: Lead intake, briefs, feedback and forms
watchouts: collect only necessary personal data
verify retention and export controls

tools.name: Manychat
watchouts: platform policy and messaging consent
account and country eligibility
approval before sending campaigns

tools.name: Supermetrics
watchouts: likely paid at scale
verify source connectors and data permissions

tools.name: Fathom
tools.purpose: Meeting notes, transcripts and action items
watchouts: obtain participant consent
avoid recording confidential calls without permission
review data retention

tools.name: Loom
tools.purpose: Screen recordings, walkthroughs and client proposals
watchouts: remove private tabs and customer information from recordings

tools.name: Gamma
watchouts: human review for accuracy, licensing and brand consistency

tools.name: Notion
tools.purpose: Documentation, project records and team knowledge
watchouts: permission design and data export
do not duplicate the War Room source of truth without a sync plan

tools.name: Canva
tools.purpose: Editable graphics, templates and marketing assets
watchouts: verify content licences and template redistribution rights

tools.name: v0
watchouts: review generated code, dependencies, accessibility and security

tools.name: Cursor
tools.purpose: AI-assisted code editing and repository work
watchouts: review code changes and data handling before using private repositories

tools.name: Supabase
watchouts: row-level security, backups, secrets and environment separation

tools.name: Cloudflare
tools.purpose: Static hosting, DNS, edge functions and security
watchouts: verify quotas, data location and billing triggers

tools.name: GitHub
tools.purpose: Code, issues, branches, pull requests and CI
watchouts: protect secrets, branch reviews and CI permissions

tools.name: Adobe Express
watchouts: verify plan limits, rights and export options

tools.name: ElevenLabs
watchouts: consent and rights for voice cloning
verify commercial-use plan

tools.name: Google Flow
watchouts: availability, credits and export terms may vary

integrationRule: Use native O'BUUMBA modules for core records and workflows; connect only through official APIs, OAuth or approved connectors; otherwise provide a guided handoff.
